production.method: built-in ImageGen with existing character reference; native-size independent sprites
production.prompt: Draw an eight-phase in-place eastward (screen RIGHT) walking sprite sheet of this identical Dungeons VTT character. Input 1 is exact appearance; do not alter face, hair, complexion, brown cloth, white eye, or height. Difficult requirement: true AND clearly visible alternation. She has ONE wood-and-metal prosthesis on the RIGHT lower leg and exactly one natural brown lower leg with a simple leather sandal. The prosthetic foot must be FORWARD only at frame 1 landing and frame 8 swinging. The NATURAL foot must be FORWARD at frame 4 swinging and frame 5 landing. Frame 1: prosthetic heel at rightmost foreground, natural foot behind toward left. Frame 2: prosthetic planted, natural foot lifts. Frame 3: natural foot clearly crosses in front of planted prosthesis. Frame 4: natural foot in air farthest right, prosthesis planted toward left. Frame 5: natural heel at rightmost foreground, prosthetic foot trailing toward left. Frame 6: natural planted, prosthesis lifts. Frame 7: prosthetic foot clearly crosses in front of natural. Frame 8: prosthetic foot swings farthest right, natural foot planted toward left. The step follows continuous displacement, NO anatomical swaps. Arms counter-swing clearly and her posture stays upright. Fixed right profile with slight tactical view from above, keep planted soles and stable head height. 1536x1024 or larger, 3:2 landscape, exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, read left-to-right within rows, with wide gaps and at least 15px transparent padding on all sides of each character. No text, ground, shadows, background, dividers, weapons, or extra objects. Transparent RGBA.

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct PNG phases verified
